standard_prerequisites.name: Power series rings over Cohen rings are formally smooth, and continuous maps lift along surjections of complete local rings

standard_prerequisites.name: Regular local rings give flat maps with regular fibre

core_obligations: Choose the power series presentations of the two rings with the Cohen structure theorem (proof lines 9794-9799).
Lift the composition to a map between the power series rings (proof lines 9800-9806).
Change the target presentation by adjoining shifted variables to arrange the regular system of parameters condition (proof lines 9807-9814).
Record flatness and regularity of the fibre (proof lines 9815-9816).
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the standard diagram expressing a local homomorphism of complete Noetherian local rings as a quotient of a map between power series rings over fields or Cohen rings, with surjective horizontal arrows and with the vertical map sending a regular system of parameters to part of a regular system of parameters. The proof chooses the two power series presentations using the Cohen structure theorem, lifts the composition along the formally smooth power series ring by the lifting result for continuous maps, and then performs an explicit change of the target presentation by adjoining new variables shifted by the images of the source variables, which arranges the regular system of parameters condition; the flatness and regular fibre assertions follow from the regularity inputs.
